metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for claude-afk, the zero-dependency Telegram bridge for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claude-afk
plugins.description: Keep talking to Claude Code from Telegram when you step away: you write plain text, Claude answers, and it all lands in the session you were already in — same context, same tools. Tool permissions are approved with yes/no along the way, and a live message shows what is running.
